plan.title: feat(packaging): OpenPackage distribution manifest for deft-directive tiered skills

narratives.Description: Add an OpenPackage package (openpackage.yml + skills tree) that tier-delivers deft-directive consumer skills as daily-core, standard, and advanced for Cursor, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Keep distribution-layer (A) only with no runtime skill router, document install beside npm @deftai/directive, and keep AGENTS.md pointer-thin without skill enumeration.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want an OpenPackage tiered skill manifest for deft-directive, so that consumers can install daily-core skills without paying always-on frontmatter for deferred workflows.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Create packaging/openpackage/ (or content/openpackage/) package dir with openpackage.yml per https://openpackage.dev/docs structure (skills/, optional root/, README). 2) Tier skills from content/skills/: daily-core = deft-directive-setup, sync, build, pre-pr, review-cycle, triage; advanced = release, swarm, debug, article-review (+ similar); remaining operational skills = standard. Document tiers in package README. 3) Wire platform targets for Cursor + Codex CLI + OpenCode minimum (OpenPackage platforms mapping); do not build runtime router (B). 4) Document install path in UPGRADING.md and README.md alongside npm i -g @deftai/directive (opkg install path or local package path). 5) Ensure AGENTS.md stays pointer-thin — no skill enumeration (Q1). Optional thin pointer template under package root/ if needed. 6) Add a smoke check or doc-verified acceptance note that daily-core Cursor frontmatter stays ~<=2080 B (spike measurement); CHANGELOG [Unreleased] brief entry Closes #2462. Verify: task check --allow-over-cap; optional opkg list/smoke if CLI available.
narratives.Origin: Enriched for swarm from #2462 under epic #2369 Wave 3 action

narrative.Acceptance: Given the new package dir, when openpackage.yml is present with skill tiers, then opkg-compatible structure exists for deft-directive consumer content.
Given content/skills, when tiers are declared, then daily-core is the six spike skills and advanced includes release/swarm/debug/article-review.
Given UPGRADING.md/README.md updates, when an operator follows them, then OpenPackage install is documented next to npm engine install without a runtime router.
Given the package lands, when PR merges, then CHANGELOG cites Closes #2462 and task check is green.
